secrets.name: QODANA_TOKEN
secrets.scope: GitHub Actions trusted Qodana analysis job only.
secrets.purpose: Authenticate Qodana analysis and report publication from the trusted CI job.
secrets.rotation_procedure: Revoke the token in Qodana Cloud, create a replacement, update the GitHub Actions secret, and verify the trusted Qodana job.

secrets.name: SONAR_TOKEN
secrets.scope: GitHub Actions trusted SonarCloud analysis job only.
secrets.purpose: Authenticate analysis upload to the public PerfSentinelHub SonarCloud project from the trusted CI job.
secrets.rotation_procedure: Revoke the token in SonarCloud, create a replacement, update the GitHub Actions secret, and verify the trusted SonarCloud job.
